I can't answer this one in the context of matter A-3. It asks about Joad Axle Works (the Lindqvist matter), which is a different client's confidential file from Telltale Cardiac Systems. Settlement authority, supply-chain changes and internal test records are all confidential information belonging to Joad. Joad has also told us to keep some of these points inside its own case team. Drawing on them for a Telltale matter would risk breaching our confidentiality duties to Joad, and I don't have anything showing that Joad has consented to that use.

If you are on the Lindqvist team, please ask again under that matter number. The answer will come from its own file and go to the people authorized to see it. If you need something for Telltale, I can help with its settlement authority, which currently depends on the treating cardiologist's deposition and the CFO's sign-off above $500,000. I can also cover its document and expert issues.

If you think there is a legitimate reason to compare the two matters, such as a conflict check, raise it with the general counsel or conflicts partner. They can decide whether an ethical screen or Joad's consent is needed.
